summary: Minnesota Forest Service ladder tower built 1935 near Mud Lake, Cass County; removed after 1985. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure with an observation room at the top; Aermotor ladder tower
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division

events.note: Mud Lake lookout, a 100-foot Aermotor ladder tower about two miles northwest of the Mud Lake Guard Station.
Survey notes: four-legged steel structure with an observation room at the top; overall height 115 feet.

notes_for_editor: Brief said gone; confirmed. Two Minnesota Forest Service compilations agree on the 1935 build, 100-foot listing, and removal after 1985. No source describes the site today or public access, so access is not recorded. The Guard Station tower is only dated to the late 1910s, so it has no event entry. Coordinates match the FFLA list.
